description: List all tags associated with a specific Zendesk ticket. Use when you need to retrieve the tags assigned to a particular ticket for categorization, filtering, or reporting purposes.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing tags on a specific Zendesk ticket.

ticket_id.description: The numeric ID of the ticket whose tags to retrieve. Must be a non-null integer. Obtain from zendesk.list_zendesk_tickets, zendesk.get_zendesk_ticket_by_id, or other ticket-related actions.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

inputSchema.title: GetZendeskTicketsTagsRequest

name: get_zendesk_tickets_tags

GetZendeskTicketsTagsResponse.description: Response containing tags for a specific Zendesk ticket.

tags.description: An array of tag names associated with the ticket.
tags.title: Tags
